suite.name: CB Suite
suite.notes: Adds Reference - Aspire: install it from the Apps page. Aspire's API status now also watches the parts of Aspire that Reference reads.

dashboard.name: CB Dashboard
dashboard.notes: Snow Event board: each route's strip of stops is wide enough to show its progress at a glance, the "of stops" line under the gauge no longer runs into the dial, and a kind of work with one route says "1 route".

requests.name: Equipment Requests - Aspire
requests.notes: In a small window the sidebar now scrolls instead of cutting off its last items and the Aspire connection. If Aspire is briefly busy (too many requests at once), the app waits a moment and tries again instead of showing an error.

photos.name: Property Photos - Aspire
photos.notes: In a small window the sidebar now scrolls instead of cutting off its last items and the Aspire connection. If Aspire is briefly busy (too many requests at once), the app waits a moment and tries again instead of showing an error.

reference.name: Reference - Aspire
reference.notes: Tables now always fit their box: on Contacts, emails wrap at the @, phone numbers stay whole with room to the edge, and nothing is cut off. In a smaller window, tables tighten up and less important columns step aside; stat tiles wrap instead of squeezing; the sidebar scrolls.
